'''Manaan Retreat''' was type of real estate property on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], available on the [[Stronghold directory terminal|Stronghold market]] during the [[Inter-Sith Wars period]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Manaan Retreat is the Manaan stronghold introduced in update 5.3 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''.
